label: Zero-to-One Visionary
shortDescription: You create what does not yet exist. You see possibility before structure and optimize for breakthrough value and direction-setting clarity.

strengthsPoints.title: Future Framing
strengthsPoints.description: You see possibilities before they're obvious. You clarify what should exist when others are still reacting.

strengthsPoints.title: Momentum Creation
strengthsPoints.description: Your energy pulls teams out of ambiguity. You make bold ideas feel achievable.

strengthsPoints.title: Problem Reframing
strengthsPoints.description: You challenge assumptions and redefine the starting point. This often unlocks breakthrough direction.

strengthsPoints.title: Narrative Clarity
strengthsPoints.description: You articulate vision in ways that inspire alignment and belief.

risksPoints.title: Idea Over-Rotation
risksPoints.description: You may move toward the next concept before the current one matures.

risksPoints.title: Constraint Friction
risksPoints.description: Operational realities can feel limiting rather than enabling.

risksPoints.title: Underweighting Iteration
risksPoints.description: You may undervalue incremental refinement in favor of step-change thinking.

risksPoints.title: Execution Gaps
risksPoints.description: Without strong partners, vision can outpace delivery.

growthPathPoints.title: Depth & Follow-Through
growthPathPoints.description: Stay with ideas long enough to refine, ship, and iterate. Compounding impact comes from sustained execution, not just bold beginnings.

growthPathPoints.title: Systems Awareness
growthPathPoints.description: Zoom out from the concept to the architecture. Strong ideas endure when they're structurally sound.

growthPathPoints.title: Operational Fluency
growthPathPoints.description: Develop comfort with constraints, trade-offs, and delivery mechanics. Vision accelerates when grounded in reality.

growthPathPoints.title: Evidence Calibration
growthPathPoints.description: Balance instinct with validation. Knowing when to test — and how — sharpens strategic credibility.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Give Them Strategic Problems, Not Just Tasks
tipsForManagersPoints.description: You thrive when shaping direction. Assign ambiguous, high-leverage challenges — not incremental maintenance work.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Pair Vision with Strong Executors
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Complement you with delivery-focused partners to ensure ideas mature into outcomes.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Clarify Constraints Early
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Frame boundaries clearly so creativity stays grounded and productive.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Measure Progress, Not Just Ideas
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Encourage follow-through by defining what success looks like beyond ideation.

label: Systems Thinker
shortDescription: You bring coherence to complexity as an experience architect. You design for scalability, logical architecture, and long-term integrity.

strengthsPoints.title: Architectural Clarity
strengthsPoints.description: You bring coherence to complex ecosystems. Fragmentation rarely survives your scrutiny.

strengthsPoints.title: Scalable Design
strengthsPoints.description: You think beyond features toward platforms, flows, and long-term integrity.

strengthsPoints.title: Cross-Functional Translation
strengthsPoints.description: You bridge product, engineering, and design with structural logic.

strengthsPoints.title: Dependency Awareness
strengthsPoints.description: You anticipate second- and third-order effects others miss.

risksPoints.title: Over-Structuring Early
risksPoints.description: You may design for scale before value is fully validated.

risksPoints.title: Analysis Stall
risksPoints.description: Complexity can lead to hesitation rather than motion.

risksPoints.title: Perfection of Frameworks
risksPoints.description: You may refine systems beyond what the moment requires.

risksPoints.title: Reduced Agility
risksPoints.description: Rapid pivots can feel destabilizing.

growthPathPoints.title: Bias Toward Action
growthPathPoints.description: Not every structure needs full definition before testing. Momentum often clarifies what architecture cannot.

growthPathPoints.title: Narrative Influence
growthPathPoints.description: Translate complex systems into compelling stories. Structure persuades more effectively when it's human.

growthPathPoints.title: Comfort with Imperfection
growthPathPoints.description: Allow temporary inconsistency when speed matters. Coherence can evolve over time.

growthPathPoints.title: Growth Sensitivity
growthPathPoints.description: Deepen your understanding of metrics and behavioral outcomes. Systems must not only scale — they must perform.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Involve Them Early in Structural Decisions
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Bring you into roadmap and platform conversations before fragmentation occurs.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Set Scope Boundaries
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Prevent over-architecting by defining what level of system maturity is required now.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Encourage Iterative Structuring
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Reinforce that systems can evolve. Not everything must be fully resolved at once.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Recognize Invisible Impact
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Much of your value is preventative. Acknowledge coherence and scalability wins.

label: Growth & Optimization Designer
shortDescription: You improve measurable outcomes. You see funnels, levers, and behavioral triggers and optimize for activation, retention, and conversion.

strengthsPoints.title: Metric Fluency
strengthsPoints.description: You understand how design decisions influence measurable outcomes.

strengthsPoints.title: Experimentation Discipline
strengthsPoints.description: You iterate quickly and learn systematically.

strengthsPoints.title: Friction Detection
strengthsPoints.description: You identify where users drop off and why.

strengthsPoints.title: Performance Alignment
strengthsPoints.description: You keep product decisions tied to business impact.

risksPoints.title: Local Optimization
risksPoints.description: You may improve a funnel while weakening the broader experience.

risksPoints.title: Short-Term Bias
risksPoints.description: Immediate wins can overshadow long-term positioning.

risksPoints.title: Metric Tunnel Vision
risksPoints.description: Not everything valuable is measurable.

risksPoints.title: Reduced Comfort with Ambiguity
risksPoints.description: Undefined problems may feel less energizing.

growthPathPoints.title: Strategic Horizon
growthPathPoints.description: Move beyond metrics to product positioning and long-term differentiation. Optimization gains power when tied to vision.

growthPathPoints.title: Ecosystem Thinking
growthPathPoints.description: Consider how experiments impact the broader product experience. Local wins should not create systemic friction.

growthPathPoints.title: Discovery Confidence
growthPathPoints.description: Practice leading ambiguous problem framing, not just measurable improvements. Early clarity multiplies later growth.

growthPathPoints.title: Craft Elevation
growthPathPoints.description: Refine aesthetic and experiential nuance. Emotional resonance amplifies performance.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Tie Design to Clear Metrics
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Provide measurable goals and access to data. You operate best with feedback loops.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Expand Your Strategic Exposure
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Invite you into positioning and roadmap discussions to broaden your horizon beyond optimization.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Encourage System Awareness
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Help you see second-order effects of experiments across the experience.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Reward Learning Velocity
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Celebrate disciplined experimentation, not just metric wins.

label: Craft Purist
shortDescription: You elevate quality and emotional resonance. You notice the subtlety others overlook and optimize for detail, clarity, and aesthetic integrity.

strengthsPoints.title: Detail Sensitivity
strengthsPoints.description: You notice nuance others overlook — spacing, tone, motion, clarity.

strengthsPoints.title: Emotional Precision
strengthsPoints.description: You elevate trust and resonance through thoughtful execution.

strengthsPoints.title: Quality Elevation
strengthsPoints.description: You raise the bar for what "good" looks like.

strengthsPoints.title: Brand Integrity
strengthsPoints.description: You protect coherence across touchpoints.

risksPoints.title: Perfection Drag
risksPoints.description: You may delay progress in pursuit of polish.

risksPoints.title: Speed Friction
risksPoints.description: Rapid environments can feel misaligned with your standards.

risksPoints.title: Over-Indexing on Aesthetics
risksPoints.description: Strategic trade-offs may feel like compromises.

risksPoints.title: Personal Attachment
risksPoints.description: Craft investment can make feedback harder to absorb.

growthPathPoints.title: Speed Under Constraint
growthPathPoints.description: Define what high quality means for this stage. Precision and velocity can coexist.

growthPathPoints.title: Metric Fluency
growthPathPoints.description: Understand how design detail influences activation, trust, and retention. Craft becomes strategic when measurable.

growthPathPoints.title: Influence Without Friction
growthPathPoints.description: Advocate for excellence in ways that align, not alienate. Elevation requires coalition-building.

growthPathPoints.title: Systems Literacy
growthPathPoints.description: Design for scale, not just perfection. Craft at the system level compounds across teams.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Protect Quality Where It Matters
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Be explicit about where craft is a differentiator — and where speed is the priority.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Set Clear Quality Bars
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Define what "excellent" means in context to avoid perfection drag.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Connect Craft to Outcomes
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Help you see how design detail influences trust, engagement, and retention.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Create Psychological Safety Around Feedback
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Craft-oriented designers often attach deeply to your work. Normalize iteration.

label: Evidence-Driven Researcher
shortDescription: You understand before acting. You search for truth beneath assumptions and optimize for insight depth and validated learning.

strengthsPoints.title: Insight Depth
strengthsPoints.description: You uncover patterns beneath surface behavior.

strengthsPoints.title: Decision De-Risking
strengthsPoints.description: You reduce costly missteps through validation.

strengthsPoints.title: Empathy Anchoring
strengthsPoints.description: You ground product direction in real human needs.

strengthsPoints.title: Pattern Recognition
strengthsPoints.description: You synthesize across signals to reveal themes.

risksPoints.title: Momentum Slowdown
risksPoints.description: Over-validation can delay necessary action.

risksPoints.title: Certainty Bias
risksPoints.description: You may hesitate when data is incomplete.

risksPoints.title: Over-Scoping Research
risksPoints.description: Curiosity can expand beyond practical limits.

risksPoints.title: Influence Gap
risksPoints.description: Insights may lose impact if not framed strategically.

growthPathPoints.title: Informed Risk-Taking
growthPathPoints.description: Not every decision requires full certainty. Learn when confidence is sufficient to move forward.

growthPathPoints.title: Strategic Framing
growthPathPoints.description: Move from insight provider to direction shaper. Research gains power when it guides decisions.

growthPathPoints.title: Synthesis Velocity
growthPathPoints.description: Distill patterns quickly and clearly. Insight only matters when it drives action.

growthPathPoints.title: Narrative Clarity
growthPathPoints.description: Communicate findings as stories, not reports. Influence grows when data resonates emotionally.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Give Them Decision Influence, Not Just Data Tasks
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Position you as insight partners in strategic conversations.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Set Time-Boxed Research Cycles
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Encourage depth while maintaining forward momentum.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Clarify Confidence Thresholds
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Define what level of certainty is needed to move forward.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Encourage Storytelling
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Support development of executive-ready narratives, not just research reports.

label: Design Operator
shortDescription: You make excellence repeatable. You see friction in systems—not just products—and optimize for consistency, workflow clarity, and scalable quality.

strengthsPoints.title: Process Clarity
strengthsPoints.description: You reduce chaos through structure and alignment.

strengthsPoints.title: Systematized Quality
strengthsPoints.description: You make excellence repeatable, not accidental.

strengthsPoints.title: Cross-Team Coordination
strengthsPoints.description: You align roles, rituals, and expectations.

strengthsPoints.title: Infrastructure Building
strengthsPoints.description: You strengthen the foundation others build upon.

risksPoints.title: Process Overhead
risksPoints.description: Structure can become heavier than necessary.

risksPoints.title: Creativity Compression
risksPoints.description: Too much governance can limit exploration.

risksPoints.title: Rigidity Under Change
risksPoints.description: Evolving contexts may challenge established systems.

risksPoints.title: Distance from Product Work
risksPoints.description: Operational focus can pull you away from craft.

growthPathPoints.title: Craft Depth
growthPathPoints.description: Maintain hands-on design sharpness. Infrastructure earns trust when paired with execution.

growthPathPoints.title: Simplification Discipline
growthPathPoints.description: Add structure only when necessary. The best systems reduce complexity rather than increase it.

growthPathPoints.title: Vision Framing
growthPathPoints.description: Practice articulating what should exist — not just how work flows. Direction complements coordination.

growthPathPoints.title: Adaptive Flexibility
growthPathPoints.description: Build processes that evolve with the team. Durable systems allow room for creativity.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Give Them Authority Over Systems
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Empower you to define rituals, workflows, and design standards.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Prevent Process Bloat
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Periodically audit systems to ensure simplicity and relevance.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Maintain Craft Exposure
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Ensure you still engage in product work to retain credibility.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Recognize Infrastructure Wins
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Operational excellence often goes unnoticed. Make it visible.

label: Embedded Strategic Partner
shortDescription: You influence product direction at a systemic level. You connect design to business strategy and optimize for alignment and long-term leverage.

strengthsPoints.title: Strategic Framing
strengthsPoints.description: You elevate conversations beyond features to direction.

strengthsPoints.title: Influence Without Authority
strengthsPoints.description: You align stakeholders across competing priorities.

strengthsPoints.title: Trade-Off Clarity
strengthsPoints.description: You surface what decisions truly mean.

strengthsPoints.title: Business Fluency
strengthsPoints.description: You connect design choices to long-term leverage.

risksPoints.title: Over-Alignment
risksPoints.description: Seeking consensus may slow decisive action.

risksPoints.title: Distance from Execution
risksPoints.description: Strategic focus can reduce hands-on sharpness.

risksPoints.title: Abstraction Drift
risksPoints.description: Conversations may rise above tangible outcomes.

risksPoints.title: Influence Fatigue
risksPoints.description: High relational load can dilute energy.

growthPathPoints.title: Execution Anchoring
growthPathPoints.description: Stay connected to hands-on design. Influence remains credible when grounded in craft.

growthPathPoints.title: Structural Fluency
growthPathPoints.description: Deepen your understanding of systems and dependencies. Strategic guidance strengthens when technically informed.

growthPathPoints.title: Decisive Leadership
growthPathPoints.description: Know when alignment is complete — and when to move. Progress requires clarity.

growthPathPoints.title: User Proximity
growthPathPoints.description: Anchor strategy in lived experience. Business direction must remain connected to real needs.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Include Them in Early Strategic Framing
tipsForManagersPoints.description: You are most effective before decisions are locked in.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Protect Execution Time
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Balance high-level influence work with meaningful product ownership.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Clarify Decision Rights
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Prevent alignment loops by defining who ultimately decides.

tipsForManagersPoints.title: Anchor Strategy in Users
tipsForManagersPoints.description: Encourage you to stay close to research and real-world signals.
